title: An explicit exceptional cubic normal form and exact rank-one residual
statement: Every ROC polynomial with leading F=t^2+2rt has C=DF*V+z^T M nu(w). Translate its argument by -V and update Qnew=Q-DC*V+(1/2)D2F[V,V]. For unit a,b, n=nu(b),e=Jn, global ROC is equivalent to 8Q(a,b)>=|Mn|^2+2(a^T M e)^2. The rank-one Hessian has constant rank3 and no omitted singular-chart limits. For Q=alpha*r+beta*t this is alpha+beta>=(2 sigma1^2+sigma2^2)/8; for Q=lambda(r+t), lambda>=(2 sigma1^2+sigma2^2)/16. This is the exceptional normal form, not application of the nonexceptional translation-only theorem.

requires: z=(a+d,c-b),w=(a-d,c+b),r=|z|^2,t=|w|^2,nu(w)=(u^2-v^2,2uv); argument translation removes DF*V and updates the full quadratic, rather than subtracting a QC function
Actual normalized rank-one direction R=(a,b),|a|=|b|=1; arbitrary rational full quadratic Q including cross terms, weak boundaries and determinant lineality
